apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata: {name: vuoro-postgres, namespace: vuoro-shared}
spec:
  instances: 1
  # Single instance: a minAvailable=1 PDB over one pod can never permit a
  # disruption, so it cannot protect availability -- it can only deadlock node
  # drains. Verified 2026-08-04: disruptionsAllowed=0, expectedPods=1.
  enablePDB: false
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16.13@sha256:acbed84c842730d6cefb89e7135743fe160233296b645b2f30f49fa18e2ebcf1
  storage: {size: 1Gi, storageClass: longhorn}
  # Bootstrap only runs when the Cluster is created; changing it never touches
  # the running database. Since D14 (2026-09-18, agentops#2408) the only
  # backups are the hourly pg_dump|age objects (cnpg-pgdump-age.yaml), so a
  # recreated cluster starts EMPTY: keep the app scaled down and restore the
  # newest dump before it connects (docs/backups-cnpg.md, "Restoring a
  # cluster from its dump").
  #
  # database/owner match the app secret's user ON PURPOSE: with the default
  # "app" CNPG builds the credential against an empty "app" database (0139727e).
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: vuoro
      owner: vuoro
  managed:
    roles:
      # Keep the initdb owner credential unchanged while allowing the grants
      # job to set migration-role schema ownership and default privileges.
      - name: vuoro
        login: true
        inherit: true
        inRoles:
          - vuoro_work_migration
          - vuoro_execution_migration
          - vuoro_knowledge_migration
          - vuoro_audit_migration
      - {name: vuoro_work_migration, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-work-migration}}
      - {name: vuoro_work_runtime, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-work-runtime}}
      - {name: vuoro_execution_migration, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-execution-migration}}
      - {name: vuoro_execution_runtime, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-execution-runtime}}
      - {name: vuoro_execution_completion_ingest, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-execution-completion-ingest-runtime}}
      - {name: vuoro_execution_completion_read, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-execution-completion-read-runtime}}
      - {name: vuoro_knowledge_migration, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-knowledge-migration}}
      - {name: vuoro_knowledge_runtime, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-knowledge-runtime}}
      - {name: vuoro_audit_migration, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-audit-migration}}
      - {name: vuoro_audit_runtime, login: true, inherit: true, passwordSecret: {name: vuoro-audit-runtime}}
